parameters.query:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT job_id, new_status FROM job_events WHERE changed_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE found_at >= now() - interval '7 days')                         AS found,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE found_at >= now() - interval '7 days' AND source = 'jsearch')   AS from_jsearch,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE found_at >= now() - interval '7 days' AND source = 'linkedin_alert') AS from_linkedin,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT e.job_id) FROM ev e JOIN jobs j ON j.id = e.job_id
     WHERE e.new_status = 'filtered_out' AND j.filter_reason NOT LIKE 'AI:%')                     AS rule_filtered,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT e.job_id) FROM ev e JOIN jobs j ON j.id = e.job_id
     WHERE e.new_status = 'filtered_out' AND j.filter_reason LIKE 'AI:%')                         AS ai_filtered,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT job_id) FROM ev WHERE new_status = 'scored')                             AS scored,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT job_id) FROM ev WHERE new_status = 'tailored')                           AS tailored,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT job_id) FROM ev WHERE new_status = 'approved')                           AS approved,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT job_id) FROM ev WHERE new_status = 'skipped')                            AS skipped,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT job_id) FROM ev WHERE new_status = 'applied')                            AS applied,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT job_id) FROM ev WHERE new_status = 'interview')                          AS interviews,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT job_id) FROM ev WHERE new_status = 'rejected')                           AS rejections,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT job_id) FROM ev WHERE new_status = 'offer')                              AS offers,
  (SELECT round(avg(match_score)) FROM jobs
     WHERE match_score IS NOT NULL AND found_at >= now() - interval '7 days')                     AS avg_score,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE applied_at IS NOT NULL)                                        AS applied_total,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT j.id) FROM jobs j JOIN job_events e ON e.job_id = j.id
     WHERE j.applied_at IS NOT NULL AND e.new_status IN ('interview','rejected','offer'))         AS answered_total,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT j.id) FROM jobs j JOIN job_events e ON e.job_id = j.id
     WHERE j.applied_at IS NOT NULL AND e.new_status IN ('interview','offer'))                    AS interviews_total,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) FROM (
     SELECT filter_reason AS reason, count(*) AS n FROM jobs
     WHERE status = 'filtered_out' AND found_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
     GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3) r)                                                       AS top_filters;

SELECT id, title, company, url, status,
       CASE WHEN status = 'applied' THEN (now()::date - applied_at::date)
            ELSE (now()::date - reviewed_at::date) END AS days
FROM jobs
WHERE followup_sent_at IS NULL
  AND (
        (status = 'applied'  AND applied_at  <= now() - interval '7 days')
     OR (status = 'approved' AND reviewed_at <= now() - interval '3 days')
  )
ORDER BY status, days DESC
LIMIT 15;
